title: Media requirements
content:
# Media requirements

Video and custom thumbnail requirements for YouTube, and the rules for media URLs.

Files above these limits are rejected:

- 256 GB per video
- 15 minutes on an unverified channel
- 2 MB per thumbnail after compression

Large videos (1 GB or more) can take 30 to 60 minutes or longer to process on YouTube's side.

<Callout type="warn">The video shows a "processing" state meanwhile, so do not retry the upload.</Callout>

## Videos

| Property | Shorts | Video |
|----------|--------|-------|
| Max duration | 3 minutes | 12 hours (verified), 15 minutes (unverified) |
| Min duration | 1 second | 1 second |
| Max file size | 256 GB | 256 GB |
| Formats | MP4, MOV, AVI, WMV, FLV, 3GP, WebM | MP4, MOV, AVI, WMV, FLV, 3GP, WebM |
| Aspect ratio | 9:16 or 1:1 | 16:9 (horizontal) |
| Resolution | 1080 x 1920 px (9:16) or 1080 x 1080 px (1:1) | 1920 x 1080 px (1080p) |

Recommended encoding:

| Property | Shorts | Video |
|----------|--------|-------|
| Resolution | 1080 x 1920 px | 3840 x 2160 px (4K) |
| Frame rate | 30 fps | 24 to 60 fps |
| Codec | H.264 | H.264 or H.265 |
| Audio | AAC, 128 kbps | AAC, 384 kbps |
| Bitrate | 10 Mbps | 35 to 68 Mbps (4K) |

## Custom thumbnails

Custom thumbnails work on regular videos and Shorts: YouTube applied a vertical (1080 x 1920) custom thumbnail to a Short on 2026-11-01. Set `thumbnail` on the video media item.

| Property | Requirement |
|----------|-------------|
| Format | JPEG, PNG, GIF |
| Max size | 2 MB |
| Recommended resolution | 1280 x 720 px (16:9) |
| Min width | 640 px |

Zernio enforces YouTube's rules before upload: JPEG, PNG or GIF, and 2 MB at most. Oversized images are compressed first, and rejected if they are still over 2 MB.

YouTube itself only accepts custom thumbnails on phone-verified channels ([youtube.com/verify](https://www.youtube.com/verify)).

**Unverified channel.** The video still uploads and publishes; only the thumbnail is skipped.

Zernio remembers the refusal for 7 days and does not retry thumbnails on that channel until then. After verifying, allow up to a week for thumbnails to resume.

## Media URLs

The URL must return the video bytes, not an HTML page, with no authentication and no expired link.

Or upload through the [media endpoint](/guides/media-uploads).
